description: This Java class 'DetachedSensor' provides a GUI component for displaying and interacting with sensor data, including mock voltage controls, within a larger application. It manages sensor gauges, mock controls, and window positioning.

classes.name: DetachedSensor
classes.description: A GUI component for displaying sensor data and mock voltage controls, managing window state and interactions.

methods.name: DetachedSensor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sensor display window and controls.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes the GUI components and adds gauge display.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the window at the mouse event location.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates the sensor and window title when sensor changes.

methods.name: showMockControl
methods.description: Displays mock voltage slider if applicable.

methods.name: isMockable
methods.description: Checks if the sensor can be mocked based on predefined list and mode.
